svg.text: The new man, merged: nervous system, seats, addresses, grid, regions
Drawn on the front and back nervous system figure he locked in on 27 September (FW, option A). A proposal to react to, not the build.

g.text: Trap, left, back view
Tension here 40 percent
The number is his example. What it measures is question K.
Commonly presents as
Shoulders risen, trapezius knots, upper back burn.
Your stories here
2 addresses stand on this place: Comparison, Manic Expression.
Today the whole shoulder band pulls 27.
Stories that charged them are listed here, from the journal.
The pattern under it
Carrying what is not yours. Duty overshot into martyrdom.
(today's shoulders line, in the engine)
What helps
Practices for this region. Content still to write, one set
per region, in the content pass he named.
The red line is the tension line: from the painted area
along its nerve (here the accessory nerve) to the spine.
The soft red patch is the area of effect. The squares
are the grid cells a person painted, 5 cm each.
Nothing here is a reading. The layout is the proposal.

svg.text: Regions: 24 on the front, 24 on the back. A first taxonomy
from his list: head, neck, shoulders, torso, palms, hips,
legs, knees, shins, ankle, feet. Arms, the back and the trap
added, since he pressed "my back" and "my trap".
Grid: 214 cells of 5 cm cover each view. A region is a set
of cells, so a press and a paint land on one map.
Dots: 110 places for the addresses inside the body.
Hollow: proposed in FW, not yet in the engine.
He is opaque here. The approved figure fills him at 7 percent
and the shipped page at 8.5, which is what lets the glow read
Labels on one side only. The other side mirrors it.
